input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (granted unconditionally, so it covers Vendor's processing of Customer Data), with certificates of insurance provided on request under 18.2. The clause is favourable to us in additional respects (employer's liability, primary coverage, notice of cancellation, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities), so no redline is warranted.
